description: This file contains unit tests for the `buildChannelSummary` function, testing its behavior with various channel plugin configurations such as Slack, Telegram, Signal, and fallback plugins. It imports testing utilities and plugin definitions, then defines helper functions to create mock channel plugins with different configurations. Multiple test cases verify the output string lines based on plugin states, linked status, account configurations, and other metadata.
